data.name: Dream Draw Dungeons
data.detailed_description:
A boy had a strange dream.

Unable to explain his strange dream, a boy draws it and creates a world. You play the drawing.

Dream Draw Dungeons is a top-down action RPG about a boy's dream, rendered in pixel art that stays true to how a child would imagine it. Seven realms, forty-nine dungeons, and a boss at the end of each road.

Seven realms, one dream

Travel from The Forest through The Mire, The Sunscar, The Dead City, The Frostbitten Wastes, The Ashblown Depths and The Blighted Canopy.

Each region brings its own unique environment, wildlife, ruins, and weather. Face wolves and goblins in the woods, explore sand-drowned tombs in the desert, and wander a city of the dead where the streets still hold their dogs and their soldiers.

Forty-nine dungeons, forty-nine guardians

Each region hides seven entrances: a bear cave, an old well, a flooded sluice, a burnt mill, a hornet hive, a grand theater with its stage still standing. One guardian in each holds a part of the gate key. Take all seven and the eastern gate opens onto the region's boss.

Every boss features a unique mechanic

No boss is just a scaled-up enemy with a huge health bar. The Fallen King holds his shield and enrages when it breaks. The Ashen Queen throws her own sword and floods the floor with molten pools. The Frost Golem freezes you on a clock you can only beat by warming yourself at four torches - and he snuffs them out one by one as you do it.

Build a hero

Twenty-one skills across three trees - Warrior, Rogue and Holy. Swing wider, vanish mid-fight, smite what stands in front of you. Ranks let you master what you love, but never everything, so every run feels unique.

Equipment

Discover and use a variety of weapons and armor sets across dedicated gear slots.

Every realm keeps a secret

Hidden within each of the seven realms lies an unmarked quest. Completing one unlocks a one-of-a-kind reward, ensuring no two secrets are ever the same.

New Game+

Finish the dream and begin it again, harder. Quest chains come back, skill mastery unlocks, and enemies and rewards keep scaling with every cycle.

Dual Perspectives

Toggle between pure 2D sprite mode

and an immersive Semi-3D camera at any time

Features

  • 7 Unique Realms and 49 hand-built dungeon interiors

  • 21 skills across three trees, with mastery ranks in New Game+

  • Hand-crafted bosses and mini-bosses, each with its own mechanic

  • Side quests with permanent rewards, replayable across New Game+ cycles

  • Fog-of-war world map that fills in as you explore

  • Full keyboard, mouse and gamepad support

  • Classic offline single-player experience

data.short_description: A top-down action RPG drawn from a child's dream. Explore seven hand-made pixel-art realms, clear seven dungeons in each to take the key parts from their guardians, then break into the boss arena. Build a warrior, rogue or holy hero and carry it into New Game+.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible GPU (integrated graphics are sufficient)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU with OpenGL 3.0 support
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
